Removing Parasitic Biomorphology's sumAtk is right for the lines step (LM): no list places the line, and a summary must be a line some list shows. The side effect is confirmed: the owner's own 22 Nov export (git e66098a verify/sources/nr-json/healybois.json) now fails on the phone with "unit Hive Tyrant + Tyrant Guard: Monstrous bonesword and lash whip S is changed by a rule the app cannot name: not imported" (×3 weapons). Before, it built with +1 S marked.

Acceptable for now: it is a named refusal, not a silent value. Proper fix (follow-up): keep every enhancement of a detachment the app has read readable without a list holding it. Either read the Tyranids catalogue (aiRead, as World Eaters: verify/catalog-armies.js places each enhancement on a CHARACTER its words allow, BOXES and the summary stay live, LM sees the line), or extend catalog-armies' enhancement placement to the read detachments of every catalogued faction. That would also restore phone imports of other unused enhancements.
The upload (Healybois_-_2000pts_1.json) is stamped 2026-11-26 11:04 UTC. The export carries no date, so the day it was sent is the right one: "exported 26 Nov 2026".

Only the new units' 6 labels are added. The 360 --agree items it declined are other lists' labels unrelated to this change, and the derive step lists any difference without failing, so leaving them out hides nothing this branch brings. Agreeing them belongs to their own review.
